title: Surreal AI Music Video Flying Machines-I'm Floating High - Kelly Boesch | 4K
description:
👉 If you like my work, I post new AI art and cinematic videos daily — subscribe to follow the journey.

I really love to make flying or moving contraptions. They give me a strange satisfaction when I animate them. I think it would be incredible to have your own flying machine. Thought maybe we would by now. The song is called I’m Floating High. Made using @sunomusic Images made with #midjourney and animated using #veo3 

#ai #aiart #aivideo #aimusic #suno #aiimages #flying
